🇺🇸🇮🇷 A US carrier reaches Iran by Sunday... and the deal on the table is weaker than the Obama one Trump tore up

David Pyne, a former Army officer and Missile Defense Agency executive, reads Sunday as the real deadline, because that’s when the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrives on station.

His analysis is that Trump wants at least a minimal peace framework by then, or strikes are back on the table.

The framework taking shape would let Iran keep low-level enrichment for good, which David calls a worse version of the 2015 deal that shipped out about 97% of Iran’s enriched uranium.

A second clock runs out December 11, when government funding expires and Democrats can start cutting off money for the war before they even take their seats.

David thinks Trump wants out and credits JD Vance for it, so the next five days decide whether there’s a signed framework or a new round of strikes.
